messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: HIGH_TAIL_LATENCY - tenant=\"caspian-labs\" pool=\"dedicated-us-east-2\" metric=p99_latency_seconds value=1.8s threshold=0.75s impact=prod
olivia (oncall): acked. pinging runtime + sre. I'm on it.
mike (eng-runtime): looking. any notes on request shapes? long sequences / function calls?
olivia (oncall): customer team reports a spike in long-context summarization jobs since ~10:02 UTC. top tokens/request ~ 6k.
sarah (eng-sre): that sounds like queue buildup -> oversized KV cache invalidation + large batch tokens. checking scheduler queues for that tenant now.
sarah (eng-sre): `ri-metrics query --metric p99_latency_seconds --tenant caspian-labs --pool dedicated-us-east-2 --since 15m`
deploy-bot: config-change detected for tenant=internal-test earlier, no changes for caspian-labs in last 24h.
mike (eng-runtime): I can see sustained queued requests on the dedicated shard set ds-14, dominated by seq_len>4096. backlog depth peaking at 80 concurrent queued requests.
leo (solutions): FYI CS says customer is hitting timeouts in their web UI, severity = high. they're asking for ETA.
jenn (support): customer reported degraded throughput at 10:03 UTC, some 504s. not all requests fail, but p99 is spiking.
olivia (oncall): root cause hypothesis: tenant's max_batch_tokens and scheduler weight are tuned for small chat usage; sudden large-seq workload causes large batches to form and hold the queue -> tail lag. propose temporary bespoke tuning: lower tenant.max_batch_tokens and reduce batch merging for that tenant.
mike (eng-runtime): agree. two quick levers we can flip without deployment: 1) set tenant.max_batch_tokens=1024 (was 4096) 2) set tenant.batch_merge_window_ms=20 (was 100)
sarah (eng-sre): also can apply per-tenant shaper to preferentially drain small requests: `rictl shaper set --tenant caspian-labs --small_request_weight 0.8 --large_request_weight 0.2`
olivia (oncall): make the changes. I'll coordinate with customer success / support. post commands and I'll run them.
mike (eng-runtime): running: 
```
rictl set-tenant-config --tenant caspian-labs --key max_batch_tokens --value 1024 --apply-now
rictl set-tenant-config --tenant caspian-labs --key batch_merge_window_ms --value 20 --apply-now
rictl shaper set --tenant caspian-labs --small_request_weight 0.8 --large_request_weight 0.2
```
deploy-bot: APPROVAL: auto-approved (operational change). Applying configs...
deploy-bot: SUCCESS: configs applied to tenant=\"caspian-labs\" on pool=\"dedicated-us-east-2\" (commit=cf9a12a)
sarah (eng-sre): observing runtime metrics after knob change. giving it 30s to 2m for pipelines to settle.
incident-bot: metric update: p99_latency_seconds for caspian-labs = 0.72s (was 1.8s) -- 2m after change
leo (solutions): customer CS updated: they see improvements, UI no longer timing out. :thumbsup:
oj: (typo) -- ignore
mike (eng-runtime): digging into logs. queue depth dropped from 80->12 within 90s. avg tokens per batch reduced, token-service CPU stable.
olivia (oncall): recording mitigation: lowered max_batch_tokens to 1024 and batch_merge_window to 20ms; applied shaper weights to favor small requests. immediate reduction in p99 from 1.8s -> 0.72s. impact: mitigated customer-visible timeouts.
jenn (support): customer impact note: ~1200 requests affected over 18 minutes, ~7% 504s. sent initial incident update to customer with workaround summary.
sarah (eng-sre): follow-ups: 1) consider permanent bespoke profile for caspian-labs with conservative batch tokens because they mix long-training-like requests with low-latency UI calls; 2) add eval that simulates mixed sequence distribution to catch regressions; 3) run a short load test against dedicated-us-east-2 ds-14 to validate scheduler behavior.
mike (eng-runtime): I'll file a runtime task to add an auto-detect rule: if >50% requests in 5m exceed seq_len 4096, auto-shape that tenant (opt-in).
leo (solutions): CS wants a postmortem with timeline and recommended config. I'll draft and share with participants.
olivia (oncall): handing off to sarah for follow-ups. I'm going offline in 10m but will follow thread. tagging rotation: @sarah (oncall) take post-incident ownership.
sarah (eng-sre): taking it. adding notes to incident tracker: `INC-2043216789` and assigning tasks.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident acknowledged by sarah. Pager silence restored.
mike (eng-runtime): one more observation: the dedicated pool shard had a lower-than-usual kernel preemption setting; not sure if that amplified tail. will add to analysis.
leo (solutions): thanks all — CS will schedule a call with customer tomorrow to discuss workload patterns and recommend long-term config.
olivia (oncall): closing on-call handoff. final status: mitigated -> degraded->stable. will update postmortem when available. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: CHANGELOG: tenant-config change logged (cf9a12a) -- operators can revert via `rictl set-tenant-config --tenant caspian-labs --key max_batch_tokens --value 4096` if needed.
sarah (eng-sre): last metric snapshot at 2043220400: p99=0.68s, queue_depth=9, error_rate=0.6% (down from 7%). ending handoff."
